newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks end higher, extends recent gains.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks end higher, extends recent gains.

text.p: * Toronto stocks ended higher on Thursday as inflation and rate hike fears eased * 12 of 14 sub-indices rallied, led by banks. * 95.3 million shares traded worth C$1.7 billion.
Toronto's stock market extended its winning streak to end higher on Thursday, powered by surging banks as fears of a Canadian interest rate hike eased.

The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index rose 33.27 points to 6009.90. Trading was heavy at 95.3 million shares worth C$1.7 billion. In the past three sessions, Canada's largest market jumped by more than 2.5 percent.
Banks led 12 of Toronto's 14 sub-indices to higher ground, rising almost 1.8 percent as investors put aside worries that Canada would raise interest rates to match U.S. hikes.
